directories.role: Repo entry point. Only README.md, LICENSE, CLAUDE.md and .gitignore are tracked here; everything else belongs in a first-class subdirectory. Layout SSOT: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 'Directory layout'.

What Claude reads: user-scope CLAUDE.md, settings.json plus its settings.critical.json manifest, and mcp.template.json. How each one reaches ~/.claude/ is the README.md 'What lives where' table (SSOT).
What Claude executes: skills, hooks, agents, output styles, HUD and OMC patches. The config/runtime/installer split is by purpose, not by tool - SSOT: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

One kebab-cased directory per repo-owned skill, each containing SKILL.md; the installer symlinks each into ~/.claude/skills/. Adding one also means a README.md table row (README.md 'What lives where').

Hook scripts (.py/.sh) invoked by absolute path from the rendered ~/.claude/settings.json. Basenames are deliberately left unregulated (kebab 14 / snake 9 / plain 1): renaming one silently breaks every machine that has not re-run installer/install.sh.

User-scope subagent definitions (.md carrying name/description frontmatter), vendored from Everything Claude Code rather than written here, so basenames follow upstream. Attribution SSOT: docs/third-party-agents.md.

What the user runs once per machine: install.sh / install.ps1 entrypoints, lib/ shell modules, scripts/ renderers, githooks/. The two entrypoints must stay behaviorally equivalent - SSOT: CLAUDE.md 'Editing rules' item 3.
Per-OS package lists and installers (macos/, linux/, windows/), each exposing one install entrypoint, selected by installer/install.sh.
Shell assets symlinked or sourced from $HOME (tmux.conf, claude-mouse.sh). Adding one means a link_or_copy line in both installers plus a README.md table row - SSOT: README.md 'What lives where'.

secrets.env holds the real values and is gitignored; the committed secrets.example.env lists names only. Contract SSOT: CLAUDE.md 'Secrets'. Left unenforced because ignore[] cannot express the 'example yes, real no' exception that .gitignore already handles.
Boilerplate copied into other projects on demand; files destined for a project carry the project- prefix. Read and copied, never installed.
pytest suite mirroring runtime/ and installer/ (hooks/, installer/, bin/, eval/, smoke/) plus JSON fixtures under fixtures/. Run by .github/workflows/ci.yml.

coder_eval tasks/ and experiments/ - the instrument that asks whether the harness changes outcomes, one of three manual instruments described in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md. Durable numbers live in eval/README.md; per-run artifacts stay in the gitignored eval/runs/.
Human-facing documentation, read and never installed: ARCHITECTURE / CHANGELOG / CONTRIBUTING plus kebab-cased topic files, with dated measurement and protocol notes under docs/harness/.
One folder per non-trivial change, named <YYYY-MM-DD-topic>, holding design.md and - when an execution plan was needed - plan.md; the absence of plan.md is meaningful. SSOT: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
GitHub Actions only. workflows/ci.yml runs ruff+shellcheck lint, pytest, and an install.sh idempotency smoke; it checks no structure, placement or naming rule.

patterns.description: No spaces or shell-special characters in any basename (cross-OS and shell safety).
A directory's readme uses the standard name.
Skill directory names are kebab-case - the directory name is the skill's invocation name. 18/18 existing skills conform, 0 counter-examples.
pytest collects only test_*.py, so a misnamed test file is silently never run. 37/37 tracked .py files under tests/ conform, 0 counter-examples.
Experiment configs are kebab-case - the opposite case from eval/tasks/. Recorded per directory because that is the level at which each is uniform. 6/6 conform.
Spec folders are <YYYY-MM-DD-topic>. The rule comes from the written convention in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, not from the count - only 1 spec folder exists so far.

content_conventions.description: A skill whose frontmatter has no name: never registers, and nothing reports the failure. 18/18 conform.
Auto-invocation matches against description:; without it the skill loads but never triggers. 18/18 conform.
